messages:
olivia: follow-up from the postmortem — same failure pattern during feature ramps that touch batch workers. want to lock down rollout safety items.
raj: agreed. curious which items we prioritize.
olivia: shortlist: (1) flag schema enrichment (owner, risk, deps), (2) stronger default ramp curve, (3) signal tagging so we can correlate traces/metrics to rollouts, (4) auto-rollback with blast-radius cap, (5) recurrence detector to surface repeated patterns.
marcus: on ramps, propose slower default: 0.1% -> 1% -> 5% -> 20% with configurable dwell times. avoids big surface area early.
sara: auto-rollback idea: detect error_rate delta over a sliding window and revert a single step, but never exceed a configured blast_radius_cap. also require manual confirmation for overrides.
lina_pm: owners/timelines please so PM can track remediation board.
olivia: my suggested owners: raj -> flag schema (EOW); marcus -> signal tagging & metrics (2w); sara -> rollback engine prototype + simulator (1w); olivia+eng-sre -> recurrence detector POC (3w).
raj: I'll extend flag schema with dependencies[] and risk_level. will open GH issues and add labels.
marcus: add rollout_step and flag_id to traces + metrics. eng-sre help needed for sampling increases on background jobs.
eng-sre: we can bump sampling for flagged flows. will coordinate on the ticket.
sara: prototype rollback config fields: window_s, error_pct_threshold, min_events, scope=flag_id, action=step_back, blast_radius_cap_pct. simulator will run scenarios to avoid cascading rollbacks.
olivia: also want a console "quarantine" button that immediately halts the ramp to a small safe fraction and posts an alert to the incident channel. deploy-bot should support that action.
deploy-bot: [bot] created RF-2034: "rollout-safety: schema, tagging, rollback, recurrence" assigned to raj, marcus, sara, olivia.
lina_pm: PM will track RF-2034 weekly. bring blockers to the Friday sync.
marcus: UI ask: show projected blast radius per step and a warning when it exceeds org policy.
raj: will add dependency pre-checks to the rollout controller: refuse progress if deps not stable.
sara: simulator plan: synthetic batch replay that can reproduce the spike so rollback logic is validated before any auto-action ships.
olivia: runbooks: add explicit kill-switch steps and who can trigger auto-rollback. raj will update runbooks repo.
eng-sre: we'll add a tracing tag whitelist and short-term increased sampling for experiments.
sara: I'll post a short design doc tomorrow and demo the simulator next week.
olivia: thanks — next sync Fri 10am. update RF-2034 if you swap owners. :pray:
